implementation.media: One stable native video owns playback, captions, sources, controls and loop behavior. getVideoElement supplies the native rendering target.
implementation.state: Canonical public inputs; native play promises and exact forwarded events. Explicit pause and disconnected lifetime prevent accidental autoplay restart.
implementation.sizing: Shared ordered responsive width/height inputs; default width 600px.
implementation.content: Native source/track children remain owned by their author, including Lit ranges and React portals.
implementation.loading: IntersectionObserver uniformly defers owned src/poster. Native loading support is not yet common across the tested engines.

findingsResolved: Unrelated track mutation no longer clears failure state.
Stale play completion is aborted after pause/disconnect.
Native volume changes survive unrelated property renders.
Forwarding from a shadow-contained native video avoids duplicate capture delivery.

keyboard.webkit: Native fullscreen Space playback, matching upstream media-controller behavior. Inline surface Space is not an equivalent oracle; no component shortcut override was added.

removal: Custom scrubber/progress player, replay cap, acme-play, old style producers and orphan Progress rules removed.

reproduction.media: site/assets/video/example.mp4 is synthetic video-only media. The autoplay-policy runner creates a separate silent-audio fixture. Captions are authored fixture text.
reproduction.note: Saved runners currently use local absolute paths; M25 owns portable browser orchestration.

remaining: M22 generated Video wrapper must retain React portal ownership.
M26 actual Safari/device and assistive-technology checks remain distinct from WebKit automation.
